University of Queensland Medical Endowment Scholarship 2025 is an opportunity offered by the University of Queensland, Australia, to M.D. degree applicants. The primary goal of this scholarship is to provide financial assistance to students facing economic hardship while pursuing the Doctor of Medicine (MD) program at the university. The selected students will receive $5,000 (approx. ₹4,26,840) for one year.
To be eligible, an applicant must -
be enrolled full-time in M.D. degree (Doctor of Medicine)
provide documentary evidence of financial disadvantage
not commit serious academic misconduct within the Doctor of Medicine program
The applicants must not hold another scholarship that the Dean considers similar.
The selected candidates will receive an amount of $5,000 (approx. 4,26,840) for one year.

Question: How are candidates shortlisted and selected?

Applicants are evaluated based on academic performance, demonstrated financial need, and the strength of their personal statement. A dedicated committee, led by the Dean, reviews all applications to ensure a fair and rigorous selection process.
Question: Can I accept another similar scholarship?
No, you must not receive any other scholarship deemed equivalent by the Dean.
Question: Who can I contact for more information?
For further details, refer to the scholarship page on the UQ Faculty of Medicine website or contact the scholarship office directly.
Question: What expenses does the scholarship cover?
It helps cover tuition fees for one year and may provide support for living expenses.
Question: What are the responsibilities of recipients?
Awardees must maintain full-time enrollment and uphold good academic standing throughout the MD program.
